h1: Drinkware Testing Matched to the Product and Use
lead: Choose testing around the selected material, finished product, decoration and intended use. The existing test and factory information on this website describes the available quality discussion.
html:
A test needs a defined scope

Identify the sample, test method, conditions and acceptance criterion. A photograph of equipment or an animated process does not establish a result for every SKU.

Record what the report covers

Keep the report holder, tested product or material, date and destination requirements attached to the order documentation. Do not extend one report to an untested configuration.
